Merge verified agents and publish a changelog entry / PR

Merges persisted verified agents into their destination branch, marks them and their tasks done, then (after a fully successful batch) runs post-merge publication once: a CHANGELOG.md entry and, when postMerge.prMode is open or draft, a push plus one cumulative GitHub PR per destination/target pair. Refuses to run while a daemon is alive. Rerun to retry interrupted publication.

Aliases: `m`

```sh
woco merge [flags]
```

Modifies project state. Supports `--dry-run`.

## Flags

| Flag | Alias | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--tasks` |  | string |  | Comma-separated task IDs to merge (default: all verified agents) |
| `--dry-run` |  | boolean | `false` | Show what would be merged without merging, writing state, or publishing |
| `--dev` |  | boolean |  | Enable developer mode (hidden TUI features, etc.) |

## Global flags

| Flag | Alias | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--output` | `-o` | string | `"text"` | Output format: text (default), json, or toon. Values: `text`, `json`, `toon`. |
| `--force` |  | boolean | `false` | Force overwrite / skip safety prompts |
